quotes.author: Ryan Wheeler
quotes.text: Ryan Wheeler17:09 16 Mar 24We had an amazing time with Silas. He was so friendly and let us take our paddle boards out when we got to the sandbar.Super great experience, and we saw lots of dolphins! Silas even stops the boat so you can get pics and videos of them which we thought was extra special. Definitely book this experience!

quotes.author: jim bill
quotes.text: jim bill18:31 11 Aug 23We had a great time with Cortez Coastal Cruises. We saw dolphins, found lots of shells, took a long tour of the beautiful coast, and swam at the local sand bars. It was a beautiful day. As small business owners ourselves, we will be back each time we visit. Thank you so much!

quotes.author: Mackenzie Williams
quotes.text: Mackenzie Williams21:05 08 Nov 23We booked for a family of 11 and we couldn’t have had a better day! Silis was amazing, we saw dolphins, stopped at multiple sand bars and found tons of sand dollars and crabs! He was great with the kids! Easiest stress-free boat day! 10/10 highly recommend!

quotes.author: Susie
quotes.text: Susie21:16 29 Mar 24We booked a 2 hour bay tour on 3/21. The boat was perfect and Silas was a great tour guide. Our visitors from South Carolina really enjoyed the afternoon and the sites. We will definitely be booking with him for our future boat cruises.

quotes.author: Kaelyn Hatch
quotes.text: Kaelyn Hatch19:27 08 Nov 23Silas was absolutely amazing!!! He was great with our kids and brought us to see the dolphins!! ❤️
